rationale: AGIO has gapped down ~15.6% with no news catalyst identified, making the move difficult to interpret directionally — it could be a continued flush or a mean-reversion bounce. Price is sitting at 20.9% of today's range near the 9-EMA with the last five 1-minute candles showing a slow drift lower on declining volume, offering no clean momentum signal in either direction. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.64%, VIXY +10%) which adds macro headwind to any long thesis, but the absence of a news driver and the already-extended gap make a short entry here also unattractive given the risk of a sharp technical bounce.
